boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Rowan study environments, including technology-equipped, reservable, informal, and residence-hall options.

cards.title: Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: Top floor, Robinson Hall
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or use the available PCs and extra monitors; the lounge also provides Raspberry Pis for hands-on computing work.
cards.short_summary: A computer science lounge with PCs, monitors, and maker-oriented equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies the Tech Lounge on Robinson Hall’s top floor as a free student study and work space with PCs, extra monitors, and Raspberry Pis.
cards.access_notes: Official page describes it as a free space for students; equipment availability may vary.

cards.title: The Pit
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Use the central lounge between scheduled events; during academic semesters it is designated as a lounge and study space.
cards.short_summary: An informal student-center lounge that supports studying during the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan states that the Pit serves as a central lounge and, during academic semesters, a lounge/study space.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Center’s event schedule; sound restrictions and events may affect the space.

cards.title: Student Center Room 128
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center express-scheduling room
cards.notes: Check the reservation display, then request immediate use through 25Live when the room is open; plan for a two-hour maximum.
cards.short_summary: A bookable Student Center room available for short-notice quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Center policy lists Room 128 as an express-scheduling room for quiet-study and last-minute meeting requests.
cards.source_title: Chamberlain Student Center Policies & Procedures Manual
cards.access_notes: Rowan students must confirm it is open and request it in 25Live; use ends after two hours or at the next reservation.

cards.title: Student Center Room 160
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center express-scheduling room
cards.notes: Look at the reservation display outside the room and use 25Live’s Express Scheduling feature if there is an open window.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center room designated for on-demand quiet study when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Center policy lists Room 160 as an express-scheduling room to accommodate quiet-study requests.
cards.source_title: Chamberlain Student Center Policies & Procedures Manual
cards.access_notes: Available only around scheduled reservations; a student may use it for up to two hours or until the next booking.

cards.title: Student Center Room 161
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center express-scheduling room
cards.notes: Use the posted reservation display before requesting the room in 25Live, and leave time to clear out before the next booking.
cards.short_summary: An on-demand Student Center room for a quiet, short study session.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Center policy lists Room 161 among rooms opened around reservations for quiet-study and immediate-use requests.
cards.source_title: Chamberlain Student Center Policies & Procedures Manual
cards.access_notes: Students must request immediate use through 25Live when open; use is limited to two hours or the next reservation.

cards.title: Chamberlain Student Center Expansion
cards.subtitle: Connected to the Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Set up at an open table in the addition and keep plans flexible around programs, gatherings, and Student Center traffic.
cards.short_summary: A newer Student Center addition with tables and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s 2025 opening report says the Student Center expansion includes study rooms and tables for studying.
cards.source_title: GRAND opening! Campus celebrates $31.4M Student Center expansion
cards.access_notes: Part of the Student Center; availability can be affected by events and building operations.

cards.title: Whitney Center Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Floors 2–5, Whitney Center
cards.notes: Residents can use furnished floor study rooms with dry-erase boards; bring materials and use their Rowan ID for building entry.
cards.short_summary: Furnished residence-hall study rooms with dry-erase boards.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan lists furnished study rooms with dry-erase boards on floors 2 through 5 of Whitney Center.
cards.access_notes: Whitney Center residents use Rowan ID swipe access for the building; study rooms are on floors 2–5.

cards.title: Evergreen Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Ends of hallways, Evergreen Hall
cards.notes: Evergreen residents can use the study rooms at hallway ends for focused work; return the space ready for other residents.
cards.short_summary: Residence-hall study rooms distributed along Evergreen’s hallways.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan lists study rooms at the end of each hallway in Evergreen Hall.
cards.access_notes: Located in a residence hall; access is intended for Evergreen Hall residents.

cards.entity_name: Holly Pointe Commons Pod Study Spaces
cards.title: Holly Pointe Commons Pod Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Holly Pointe Commons residential pods
cards.notes: Use the pod study areas for nearby coursework, and keep shared lounge-and-study settings workable for fellow pod residents.
cards.short_summary: Study areas integrated into Holly Pointe Commons residential pods.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan states that each Holly Pointe Commons pod includes student bedrooms, lounge and study spaces, bathrooms, and laundry rooms.
cards.access_notes: Holly Pointe Commons uses card access for building and bedroom entry; pod spaces serve residents.

cards.title: Rowan Boulevard Apartments Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard Apartments
cards.notes: Use the apartment complex’s shared study rooms for focused work, and rely on Rowan ID access to enter the residential building.
cards.short_summary: Shared study rooms within Rowan Boulevard Apartments.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s housing page states that study rooms in Rowan Boulevard Apartments receive daily housekeeping service.
cards.access_notes: Residential access is controlled by Rowan ID; the official housing page identifies shared study rooms in the complex.
